caption: The drawing depicts a figurine of a man standing on top of a pedestal. The man is wearing a black top hat, a black jacket, a white shirt, and a red tie, with his pants depicted in a brown color. He has a mustache and is holding a long, curved rod in each hand, each rod extending out to support a large, dark metallic sphere at each end. The pedestal supporting the man is tall, brown, and flares outward at the bottom into a four-legged base. The overall composition is vertically oriented, with the figure and the dark spheres being the central points of the image. The background is a blank, beige color, creating a contrast that highlights the detailed, colored depiction of the figurine and its stand.
title: Pa. German Balancing Man
